purpose: Determine whether V29 failed because the deterministic current-density backbone is underfit, or because the physical residual is locally coupled to the backbone and cannot be transplanted independently.

frozen_measurements.v14_backbone: V14 corrected conditional_mean plus train-only predicted residual DC
frozen_measurements.fourier_fields: per-cube mean-centered y fields; aggregate auto/cross power before forming power ratio and phase coherence
frozen_measurements.pooled_count: log1p of the exact galaxy-count sum in each nonoverlapping block
frozen_measurements.pooled_velocity: galaxy-count-weighted mean radial peculiar velocity; empty blocks excluded from its correlation
local_condition_checks: truth correlation with pooled count and velocity
V4 and V14 backbone correlation with truth
residual RMSE in observed and unobserved native cells
V14 residual mean and standard deviation in V14-backbone voxel deciles

coupling_control.residual: exact validation truth minus its own V14 backbone
coupling_control.operation: periodic translation of each complete residual cube while keeping its own backbone fixed
coupling_control.diagnostics: unchanged V20 Q3/Q4 definitions at q=0.99999 and physical delta=10^(4.5y)-1

predeclared_classification_thresholds.backbone_rmse_improvement: V14/V4 RMSE <= 0.98 independently in all three domains
predeclared_classification_thresholds.low_k_phase_no_harm: V14 coherence is no more than 0.02 below V4 in either k<0.5 or 0.5<=k<1 h/Mpc bin in every domain
predeclared_classification_thresholds.material_local_coupling: the median of the three translated controls fails any unchanged Q3/Q4 threshold in any domain

fixed_branches.condition: backbone improves and local coupling is not material
fixed_branches.next: audit the target-free donor descriptor rather than changing the backbone

fixed_branches.condition: backbone does not improve and local coupling is material
fixed_branches.next: replace the backbone with a multiscale conditional density model and condition the stochastic residual locally

fixed_branches.condition: backbone does not improve and local coupling is not material
fixed_branches.next: replace and validate the deterministic multiscale backbone before residual modeling

fixed_branches.condition: backbone improves and local coupling is material
fixed_branches.next: retain the improved low-k backbone but replace independent residual transport with an explicitly local conditional residual model

firewall.development_truth: diagnostic use only after the frozen registry is committed
